storm.left: This storm is the result of decades of inaction!
storm.right: Big Weather wants you scared so you buy their umbrellas.
storm.weather: I'm literally electricity. Get inside, both of you.

snow.left: Snow plows should be distributed equitably.
snow.right: Shovel your own driveway. That's freedom.
snow.weather: I'm snowing on both your driveways equally.

rain.left: Rain should be free for everyone! Oh. It is.
rain.right: I don't need the government telling me when to bring an umbrella.

rain.left: We need to invest in umbrella infrastructure.
rain.right: The free market will provide umbrellas.
rain.weather: {pop}% chance of rain. Nobody brought one.

fog.left: The fog is a metaphor for lack of transparency.
fog.right: The fog is a metaphor for lack of transparency.
fog.weather: You two agreeing is the real weather event today.

windy.left: This wind could power the whole town!
windy.right: These gusts are a hoax pushed by Big Kite.
windy.weather: Gusts to {gusts}. Hold onto your lawn chairs.

scorching.left: It's this hot and you still want to debate it?
scorching.right: In my day it was hot and we called it 'summer.'
scorching.weather: Drink water. Both of you. You're turning red.

hot.left: Shade should be a human right.
hot.weather: It's {temp}. Sit under a tree and stop yelling.

freezing.left: Freezing! Proves we need climate action!
freezing.weather: It's called winter. It happens every single year.

cold.left: Every household deserves a heating plan.
cold.right: Cold builds character. Buy a good coat.

nice.weather: Can everyone just go to a park, please?

nice.left: This sunshine is a win for the people.
nice.right: This sunshine is a win for small business.
nice.weather: I'm a sun. I don't vote.

meh.left: Gray skies. Typical of this administration.
meh.right: Gray skies. Typical of the last administration.
meh.weather: I'm a cloud. I have no opinion. I'm just here.

clearNight.left: Look at the stars. Protected by dark-sky laws!
clearNight.right: Look at the stars. No permit required!
clearNight.weather: Go to bed, both of you.
